description: A new outer container that reuses the same inner objects: `list(x)`, `d.copy()`, `{**d}`, `copy.copy(x)`.
A recursive copy of every nested mutable object: `copy.deepcopy(x)`.
The table `deepcopy` keeps of already copied objects. It makes cyclic structures copyable and keeps shared references shared inside the copy.
A number, string or `None`. `deepcopy` returns the same object because it cannot change.
A hook a class can define to control how `copy.deepcopy` copies its instances.
